module_shop_blind.col.skill: Skill (applies automatically by round, only you see it)
module_shop_blind.zone.0.name: Ancient City Vault
module_shop_blind.zone.1.name: Bastion Vault
module_shop_blind.zone.2.name: Abandoned Mine Vault
module_shop_blind.role.0.name: Treasure Hunter
module_shop_blind.role.0.desc: Round 1: locks onto the position and tier of the most valuable relic. Round 3: learns its name and value.
module_shop_blind.role.1.name: Archaeologist
module_shop_blind.role.1.desc: Round 1: shows every relic outline. Rounds 2-5: each round reveals the tier of the 2 largest unknown relics.
module_shop_blind.role.2.name: Eye of Ender
module_shop_blind.role.2.desc: Round 1: reveals the tier of 3 relics. Rounds 2-5: 2 more each round.
module_shop_blind.role.3.name: Gold Appraiser
module_shop_blind.role.3.desc: Round 1: Common-Rare sum. Round 2: dud/gem counts & set synergy. Round 3: reveals a random Epic+ tier.
module_shop_blind.role.4.name: Architect
module_shop_blind.role.4.desc: Rounds 1-5 in turn: cells taken by Mythic / Legendary / Epic / Rare / Uncommon relics.
module_shop_blind.role.5.name: Statistician
module_shop_blind.role.5.desc: Round 1: Epic+ count. Round 2: Mythic & set synergy count. Round 4: count per tier.
module_shop_blind.role.6.name: Gambler
module_shop_blind.role.6.desc: Round 3: reveals the tier of 2 random relics. Round 5: reveals all tiers. Buyout multiplier -0.2 when you bid highest.
module_shop_blind.tool.0.name: Appraisal Hammer
module_shop_blind.tool.0.desc: Pick a cell: reveals the outline and tier of the relic there (empty cells are marked).
module_shop_blind.tool.1.name: Magnifier
module_shop_blind.tool.1.desc: Pick a cell: reveals the name, grade and value of the relic there.
module_shop_blind.tool.2.name: Scanner
module_shop_blind.tool.2.desc: Reveals the tier of 2 random relics of unknown tier.
module_shop_blind.tool.3.name: Glowstick
module_shop_blind.tool.3.desc: Tells how many relics there are of each tier.
module_shop_blind.rule.tax.text: The winner gets true value - tax - price paid; tax = true value × %s%% (taken from the winner's proceeds).
module_shop_blind.rule.div.text: When a human winner takes a loss, %s%% of the loss is shared among the other humans in the room (capped per person).
module_shop_blind.rule.instant.text: Rounds 1-4: 1st bid >= 2nd bid × multiplier (%s) ends it at once. Round 5: highest bid wins. Everyone at 0, or a winner who cannot pay, is a flop.
module_shop_blind.rule.match.text: Online queue matches real players only (auto-AI fill disabled); AI Practice pits you against 4 AI personas for free with zero star coin payout.
module_shop_blind.foot.loadout: Each tool once per game · at most 1 per round · not usable after you lock a bid
module_shop_blind.queue.title: Matching
module_shop_blind.queue.wait: Matched %1$s / %2$s real players · pure PvP starts in %3$s s
module_shop_blind.queue.waiting: Matched %1$s / %2$s real players · waiting for players (no auto-AI)
module_shop_blind.queue.note: Appraiser: %s · ticket is charged at start, cancelling is free
module_shop_blind.tip.buyout: If the top bid is >= 2nd bid × %s this round, the vault sells at once
module_shop_blind.tip.final: Final round: the highest bid wins; everyone at 0 is a flop
module_shop_blind.tip.floor: Public >= %s ★ · your intel >= %s ★ (unknown relics count as Common minimum; true value is never lower)
module_shop_blind.bid.title: Round bid
module_shop_blind.bid.click: Click to enter a bid (or just type)
module_shop_blind.log.title: Intel log · %s entries
module_shop_blind.armed: %s selected: click a vault cell to use it (right-click to cancel)
module_shop_blind.foot.match.hint: Hammer / Magnifier / Sonar: select, then click a cell · locked after bidding
module_shop_blind.res.title: Reveal
module_shop_blind.res.divnote: Loss dividend %1$s%%: other humans received +%2$s ★ in total
module_shop_blind.res.hint: Hover a relic in the grid for details
module_shop_blind.hist.hint: P/L = true value - tax - price · scrollable
module_shop_blind.tool.4.name: Sonar Probe
module_shop_blind.tool.4.desc: Pick a cell: scans a 5-cell cross, marks empties, outlines hit relics and estimates regional value.
